Metadata.Title: The Nemeses
Metadata.Description: Good afternoon, agent.Your targets are Shaaf Abdul, a relations representative for Hamsun Oil's Middle Eastern sector, and In'aam Mahdavi, a radical environmentalist focused on ecoterrorism and perpetrating anti-capitalism.A straight arrow and extremely paranoid, Abdul understands that his position in the foremost international oil corporation carries its weight as a potential hostage mark, however it does not stop him from carrying out his work. His profession enables him to discuss with Middle Eastern leaders about ways to power their economies through the use of archaic fossil fuels and lobbying against the use of pro-climate products, such as electric cars. His presence at the Burj Al-Ghazali is assumed to be under a two birds meeting of celebrating with his close friend Sheikh Omar Al-Ghazali, as well as entertaining the idea of private military CICADA's acquisition with Hamsun chairman Carl Ingram.On the other side of the spectrum, an upcoming radical environmentalist cell based out of Singapore is led by the former paramilitary soldier Mahdavi and his reckless attitude towards the despotic nature of corporations that profit off destroying the climate. Mahdavi's attacks were inspired by his former stint as part of the Shadow Client's paramilitary's attacks on companies such as Quantum Leap, Dynasty Global, and Ether Biotech. His modus operandi has led him out to his home city of Dubai to track down the anonymous chairman of Hamsun Oil, of whom his spy, Zana Kazem, has been attempting to scout while performing reconnaissance around the Burj. To ensure the operation goes smoothly, Mahdavi has deployed himself into the field, disguised as one of the Burj's penthouse staff members.You will likely find Abdul waiting for his meeting with Ingram, while Mahdavi will be located somewhere near the penthouse, although, due to the recency of his infiltration, I doubt he'll be inside it.These two men are both highly volatile and, if either were to complete their plans, could cause massive international repercussions. Additionally, Mahdavi has left an explosive golf ball somewhere around the Burj as a concealable assassination method - I highly recommend you retrieve the ball as well.I trust you to deal with the matter in a time-sensitive manner. Good luck.
